# Template: labels.md (machine view)

Labeled-items index + assembly map.

**Verdict: script-perfect.** The `.aux` file *is* the compiled
registry; the view is a lookup over it plus the `\input` order of the
root tex. Nothing judgmental.

## Format

```markdown
<!-- Machine view. Generated by compile.sh at <stamp> from
     paper.aux + paper.tex. REGENERATE: sh scripts/compile.sh (after
     a build). The .tex sources are authoritative. -->

# Labels and structure

Label freshness: FRESH | STALE — paper.aux is older than <file>;
rebuild the paper and recompile.

## Labeled items (from paper.aux)

| Label | Number | Page |
|---|---|---|
| `sec:method` | 3 | 2 |

(no paper.aux — build the paper once, then recompile)

## Assembly map (paper.tex \input order)

| File | Sections found inside |
|---|---|
| sections/1_intro/intro.tex | Introduction (sec:intro) |
```

## Source & regeneration

`paper.aux` (`\newlabel{name}{{number}{page}`) and the `\input{...}`
lines of the root tex, each input file's `\section{...}` /
`\subsection{...}` / `\label{...}` scanned for the map. Staleness
rule: any `.tex`/`.bib` newer than the `.aux` → the header stamps
STALE naming the newest source. `sh scripts/compile.sh labels`.
